name: Music Player Device
description: Skeuomorphic dark music player device with a cover art screen showing track title and artist, and a tilting directional dial with play, pause, skip and volume controls.
contents: Screen with cover art, song title and band name over a gradient
Round dial with play/pause button, previous and next, volume up and down
Hidden audio element playing the current track
behavior: Play and pause toggle, skipping wraps around the track list
Next track starts automatically when one ends
Volume changes in steps between 0 and 1
Dial tilts in 3D toward the pressed control
Below 760px the device scales down in steps to fit narrow screens
editableByProps: Tracks with song, band, audio source and cover art
All device, dial and button gradients
Device width and height, control aria labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the dial tilt angles or shadows
Change control positions around the dial
needsCodeEdit.where: controlClass constant and the position classes on each control button

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Inner screen, dial and icon sizes are fixed pixel values, narrow screens use stepped scale transforms
Audio uses preload none and starts only after user interaction
